title: Note Rate Schedule — Summit Plans
content:
Rate structure of each plan of the Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage.

| Plan | Rate type | Index followed | Months between rate adjustments | Lifetime cap over the initial note rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | fixed | none | 0 | 0.00 percentage points |
| Summit Flex Fixed | fixed | none | 0 | 0.00 percentage points |
| Summit Select Line | adjustable | 30-day average SOFR | 1 | 10.00 percentage points |
| Summit Condo Line | adjustable | 30-day average SOFR | 1 | 10.00 percentage points |
| Summit Second Lien | fixed | none | 0 | 0.00 percentage points |
| Summit Estate Line | adjustable | 30-day average SOFR | 1 | 10.00 percentage points |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The three fixed plans — Summit Fixed Lump Sum, Summit Flex Fixed and Summit Second Lien — follow no index, have no adjustment interval (0 months) and no lifetime cap (0.00), because their note rate never changes.
2. The three adjustable plans — Summit Select Line, Summit Condo Line and Summit Estate Line — follow the 30-day average SOFR and adjust every 1 month. Their lifetime cap is 10.00 percentage points: the note rate may never stand more than 10.00 points above the note rate the loan carried at closing.
3. The cap is measured in percentage points over the initial note rate, not as a percent of it. For illustration only, a hypothetical loan closed at 7.125% could never carry a note rate above 17.125%.
